1d50a2bd-0890-4b61-9474-b92435185adb@ufc.why: The women's flyweight title is vacant because champion Valentina Shevchenko withdrew with a serious injury that is expected to sideline her a year, so #1 contender Natalia Silva finally gets a first title shot against #8 Wang Cong, a hard hitting former kickboxer. The co-main pits former flyweight champion Deiveson Figueiredo against surging prospect Payton Talbott, who is unbeaten since his only career loss and just beat former two division champ Henry Cejudo.
1d50a2bd-0890-4b61-9474-b92435185adb@ufc.know: A vacant title fight means no current champion is involved, so the winner becomes champion outright. UFC ranks fighters #1 to #15 in each weight class below the champ, and a numbered event like this one is reserved for the promotion's biggest cards, almost always built around a title fight.

65476e3e-e4f9-4fb3-a5c0-3b852455ccfa@nin.why: San Francisco is off to a 3-0 start and sits first in the NFC West, while Denver is 2-1 and riding a two-game win streak after beating the Rams. It is only Week 4, so this game will not clinch or eliminate anything, but a win would keep the 49ers unbeaten and show they can beat a quality opponent despite missing key defenders.
65476e3e-e4f9-4fb3-a5c0-3b852455ccfa@nin.know: The 49ers are without star pass rusher Nick Bosa and fellow edge rusher Mykel Williams, both injured, which weakens their ability to pressure the quarterback. Watch running back Christian McCaffrey, a dual run-and-catch threat who is healthy and full go, and quarterback Brock Purdy, who may exploit a Broncos defense while San Francisco's own pass rush is shorthanded.

ab41077e-e70a-4d09-8c09-b56ecfd59743@ufc.why: In the main event, the pair are ranked #4 and #10 in the UFC's official middleweight rankings, so the winner pushes closer to a title shot. Allen has won his last three fights, picking up two Fight of the Night bonuses in the process, while the fight will also mark a career first for Duncan, as the former Cage Warriors middleweight champion has never previously headlined a UFC event. In the co-main, Loopy Godinez will look to bounce back against the surging Ketlen Souza.
ab41077e-e70a-4d09-8c09-b56ecfd59743@ufc.know: UFC rankings run from the champion down through number one to fifteen in each weight class, so a fight between two ranked men like Allen and Duncan carries real title-picture weight. A Fight Night card has no championship bout, but it is where rising fighters build the resumes that can eventually earn them a shot at gold.
